description: The line plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) variants as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), ranging from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” is linearly scaled with integer tick marks at 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” is linearly scaled from 33.0 to 36.5, with major tick marks every 0.5 units. Six distinct lines represent different DPR configurations: “DPR w/o query” (black solid line) remains flat at approximately 34.2 across all S values; “DPR w/ gold” (yellow line with circle markers) starts near 33.0 at S=1 and increases steadily to about 35.0 at S=10; “DPR w/ top-1” (green line with circle markers) begins at 33.0, rises sharply to 35.5 at S=3, and continues increasing gradually to ~36.4 at S=10; “DPR w/ bottom-1” (purple line with circle markers) starts at ~34.8, dips slightly to ~34.7 at S=5, then stabilizes around 34.7–34.8; “DPR w/ random” (blue line with circle markers) begins at ~34.8, peaks at ~35.7 at S=3, then gently declines to ~35.7 at S=10; and “DPR w/ curriculum” (red line with circle markers) starts at ~35.6, rises to ~36.0 at S=6, then plateaus near 36.0. Two horizontal dashed lines are present: a red dashed line at ~35.5 and a green dashed line at ~34.7, likely indicating baseline or reference thresholds. All lines use circular markers, and except for “DPR w/o query,” all show some degree of upward trend or variation with increasing S.
